mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, leading to higher corporate earnings expectations and positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive (t-test p>0.05 vs zero).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.0% triggers market concerns about persistent inflation, leading to expectations of aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0% (t-test p>0.05 vs zero).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and declines in UNRATE (indicating a tightening cycle amid a tight labor market) signal an imminent economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening in tight labor market
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth exceeding 0.5% monthly), strong employment conditions support consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the tight labor market condition (t-test p>0.05 vs zero).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity and supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising (t-test p>0.05 vs zero).

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST below 1200.0 thousand units) signal weak residential construction and broader economic weakness, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is below 1200.0 (t-test p>0.05 vs zero).

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer credit (RSAFS) combined with stable or declining FEDFUNDS (indicating accommodative monetary policy) signals strong consumer spending and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with strong credit growth
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS rising and FEDFUNDS stable/falling) fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of cases (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.25% over three months) signals an active monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% over three months (t-test p>0.05 vs zero).
